Core Active Vocabulary (12 items):

mother — the woman who is your parent. Example: My mother is a nurse.
father — the man who is your parent. Example: My father works in an office.
parents — your mother and father. Example: My parents live in Leeds.
sister — a girl or woman with the same parents as you. Example: My sister is a student.
brother — a boy or man with the same parents as you. Example: I have got one brother.
husband — the man a woman is married to. Example: Her husband is a doctor.
wife — the woman a man is married to. Example: His wife works here.
child — a young person, a son or daughter. Example: Their child is two years old.
grandparents — the parents of your parents. Example: My grandparents live near us.
friend — a person you like and know well. Example: She is my best friend.
neighbour — a person who lives near you. Example: My neighbour is very kind.
colleague — a person you work with. Example: My colleague speaks three languages.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• This is my ...
• I have got two ...
• My sister's husband ...
• How many brothers have you got?
• My family is small.

Complete the sentence with a word from the list.
The possessive 's is /s/, /z/ or /ɪz/.
Kate's /s/, sister's /z/, George's /ɪz/
Listen and repeat three times.
Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: Possession (my family, her brother).
Use a possessive adjective before the noun (my mother, her brother) and 's after a person (my sister's husband). Use have got to describe your family: I have got two brothers.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct possessive.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: My sister's husband is a teacher.
My sister husband is a teacher.
My sisters's husband is a teacher.

elements.content: Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
I have got a small family. My parents live in Leeds. My sister's husband is a teacher and their child is two. My grandparents live near us.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: Have you got any brothers or sisters? B: Yes, one sister and two brothers. A: Is your sister married? B: Yes, her husband is a doctor.
